k8sman-demo 0.3.1 is running as release "web" in namespace "helm-demo".

Try it:
  kubectl -n helm-demo port-forward svc/web 8080:80
  curl http://localhost:8080/

hooks.name: web-smoke
hooks.manifest:
apiVersion: batch/v1
kind: Job
metadata:
  name: web-smoke
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: k8sman-demo
    app.kubernetes.io/instance: web
    app.kubernetes.io/version: "1.27"
    app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: Helm
    helm.sh/chart: k8sman-demo-0.3.1
  annotations:
    "helm.sh/hook": post-install,post-upgrade
    "helm.sh/hook-weight": "5"
    "helm.sh/hook-delete-policy": before-hook-creation
spec:
  backoffLimit: 0
  ttlSecondsAfterFinished: 600
  template:
    spec:
      restartPolicy: Never
      containers:
        - name: smoke
          image: busybox:1.36
          command: ["sh", "-c", "echo smoke test for web ok"]

upgradeBlocked: this release uses subcharts (cache) that Helm doesn't store with the release, so upgrading from the stored chart would delete their resources. Upgrade from the chart source with the helm CLI instead
